## Summary

Syncs this repo with changes that landed in `self-evolving/literature-template` since repo creation (PRs #22, #28, #29, #30).

- **`quartz.ts`** — adds `requireAbsoluteHttpUrl`, `giscusAppHost()`, `GiscusContentTab` type/constant, expands `giscusComments()` with tabs validation, `GISCUS_CONTENT_REPO`, `SEPO_PREVIEW_PR/BRANCH/DOMAIN/API` env vars, `appHost`, updated default themes (`sepo_light`/`sepo_dark`), removes `themeUrl`; preserves paper-at-root `isPaperNote`/`isLibraryPage`/`not-index` logic (this repo's `index.md` is `type: paper`)
- **`quartz/components/Comments.tsx`** — simplified to a `sepo-embed` config div; drawer UI (trigger, panel, themes) now ships from `sepo.js` hosted by the Sepo comments service
- **`quartz/components/scripts/comments.inline.ts`** — replaced giscus direct-embed logic with sepo.js loader that forwards config attributes and handles SPA navigation cleanup
- **`.github/workflows/agent-site-preview.yml`** — switches permissions to `deployments: write`, uses `setup-agent-runtime` action, replaces PR comment step with `publish-preview-deployment.js` CLI + GitHub Deployment events, adds teardown job cleanup steps with `inactivate-preview-deployments.js`

Closes #7

## AI Review Synthesis > Dual-agent review by **Claude** and **Codex**. > Requested by @lolipopshock. Inline comment posted successfully (PRRC ID `3393945889`). Now producing the synthesis. --- ## Summary of PR/Issue PR #8 syncs this repo with four upstream changes in `self-evolving/literature-template` (PRs #22, #28, #29, #30). The headline changes are: (1) migrating the Giscus comments widget to a hosted `sepo.js` loader — hollowing `Comments.tsx` and `comments.inline.ts` down to a thin config-div + script tag pattern — and (2) replacing the mutable "Sepo preview: URL" PR comment with proper GitHub Deployment events, driven by two new CLI scripts invoked from an updated `agent-site-preview.yml`. `quartz.ts` gains input validation helpers (`requireAbsoluteHttpUrl`, tabs/contentRepo format checks) and several new env-var bindings. Closes #7. ## Review The `sepo.js` comments migration (three of the four changed files) is clean and ready to merge. The workflow change is architecturally correct but **non-functional as written**: it calls two CLI scripts whose TypeScript sources are absent from this repository, so every deploy and teardown run will fail at the `node` invocation. | Issue | Severity | Description | | -- | -- | -- | | Missing CLI source files: `publish-preview-deployment.ts` and `inactivate-preview-deployments.ts` | BLOCKING | Both scripts are called from `agent-site-preview.yml` (lines 75, 117) but do not exist in `.agent/src/cli/`. `setup-agent-runtime` rebuilds `dist/` from source on every run, so both `deploy` and `teardown` jobs will fail with `Cannot find module`. | | `data-app-host` default duplicated between `quartz.ts` and `Comments.tsx` | WARNING | `giscusAppHost()` always resolves the value, so the JSX fallback `?? "https://comment-api.sepo-preview.xyz"` is a dead branch. If the two hardcoded defaults drift, the JSX branch silently wins for misconfigured callers. | | `comments.scss` is now unreferenced dead code | WARNING | `Comments.tsx` drops the `import style` and `Comments.css = style` lines; the 179-line `quartz/components/styles/comments.scss` is now silently orphaned. | | `pull-requests: write` dropped — note for script implementer | INFO | With `SEPO_TOKEN=''` (github_token fallback), any PR-comment attempt inside `publish-preview-deployment.js` will fail silently; document this in the script or guard against it. | | `GISCUS_THEME_URL` env var removed silently | INFO | Downstream consumers who set `GISCUS_THEME_URL` will see it ignored with no warning. Low risk for a managed template sync, but a build-time `console.warn` on unrecognised env vars would help. | | `themeFor` two-way switch assumes only two themes | INFO | `null`/unset/future `"system"` all fall through to light theme. This matches current site contract but warrants a comment if a third theme value is ever added. | ## Progress - The Vercel bot confirms the preview deployed successfully — the `sepo.js` comments migration is visually verified. - The rubrics review returned N/A: `agent/rubrics` branch has not been initialized for this repo. No rubric scoring was possible and this does not affect the code verdict. - Inline comment posted on [`.github/workflows/agent-site-preview.yml` line 75](https://github.com/self-evolving/literature-example-hcllms/pull/8#discussion_r3393945889) calling out the blocking missing-scripts issue. ## Issue Details
Missing CLI source files: publish-preview-deployment.ts and inactivate-preview-deployments.ts **Cause:** `agent-site-preview.yml` was updated to call `node .agent/dist/cli/publish-preview-deployment.js` (line 75) and `node .agent/dist/cli/inactivate-preview-deployments.js` (line 117), but the corresponding `.ts` source files were not included in this sync. `setup-agent-runtime` compiles `.agent/src/` with `tsc` on every workflow run; the compiled `.js` files are never produced if the source is absent. **Candidate solutions:** 1. Add the `.ts` source files from `literature-template` (`.agent/src/cli/publish-preview-deployment.ts` and `.agent/src/cli/inactivate-preview-deployments.ts`) to this repo in the same PR. 2. Merge a prerequisite PR that adds the scripts first, then rebase this PR onto it. **Comments:** This is the single blocking issue; the rest of the PR is clean and can merge once this is resolved.
data-app-host default duplicated between quartz.ts and Comments.tsx **Cause:** `giscusAppHost()` in `quartz.ts` unconditionally passes `appHost: giscusAppHost()` to the component, making the JSX fallback `?? "https://comment-api.sepo-preview.xyz"` in `Comments.tsx` a dead branch. **Candidate solutions:** - Remove the fallback from the JSX attribute and mark `appHost` as required in the `GiscusOptions` type, making the contract explicit. - Or keep the fallback but extract the default string to a shared constant so both sites always agree.
comments.scss is now unreferenced dead code **Cause:** `Comments.tsx` removed `import style from "./styles/comments.scss"` and `Comments.css = style`. The stylesheet still exists on disk but Quartz's asset pipeline will no longer include it. **Candidate solutions:** - Delete `quartz/components/styles/comments.scss` — the sepo.js drawer ships its own styles. - If any rules are still needed for the config-div container, migrate the relevant selectors into `custom.scss`.
## Recommended Next Step **FIX_PR** — The blocking issue is concrete and mechanical: two TypeScript source files need to be added to `.agent/src/cli/`. An automated fix-pr pass can pull them from the upstream `literature-template` repository and commit them to this branch. ## Final Verdict **NEEDS_REWORK** ## Action Items - [ ] Add `publish-preview-deployment.ts` to `.agent/src/cli/` (source from `self-evolving/literature-template`) - [ ] Add `inactivate-preview-deployments.ts` to `.agent/src/cli/` (source from `self-evolving/literature-template`) - [ ] Remove the `?? "https://comment-api.sepo-preview.xyz"` fallback from `data-app-host` in `Comments.tsx` (or extract to a shared constant) - [ ] Delete or migrate `quartz/components/styles/comments.scss` now that `Comments.tsx` no longer imports it
